newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end weaker amid profit-taking, Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end weaker amid profit-taking, Brazil.

text.p: Chilean blue-chip stocks shed early gains to close lower on Monday amid profit-taking and uncertainty sparked by a sharp drop in the Brazilian market, traders said.

The slide is seen resuming at the opening with investors keeping a close eye on other Latin American bourses, they said. "The market will continue to correct, but how much will depend what happens in Brazil and the rest of the region," one trader said.
The 40-share index ended unofficially down 0.63 percent at 133.82 points.
